title: Image-Scale Robustness and Visual Recognition Performance: A Cross-Architecture Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.06051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The sensitivity of visual recognition models to changes in image scale is well established, yet the factors governing this sensitivity across heterogeneous architectures remain unclear. In this work, we investigate whether scale robustness exhibits a common quantitative structure across modern vision models. We evaluate 20 pretrained ImageNet-1K classifiers spanning seven architectural families, including convolutional, mobile, efficient, and Transformer-based architectures. By systematically reducing input image scale, we construct scale-accuracy response curves and define a characteristic scale as a compact measure of the onset of substantial recognition degradation. We then examine the relationship between characteristic scale and baseline recognition accuracy, model parameter count, architectural family, and representation stability. translated_title: 图像尺度鲁棒性与视觉识别性能：一项跨架构分析
translated_abstract: 视觉识别模型对图像尺度变化的敏感性已广为人知，但支配这种敏感性在不同异构架构间的因素仍不明确。在这项工作中，我们研究尺度鲁棒性是否在现代视觉模型中展现出共同的量化结构。我们评估了涵盖七个架构系列的20个预训练ImageNet-1K分类器，包括卷积、移动端、高效和基于Transformer的架构。通过系统地降低输入图像尺度，我们构建了尺度-精度响应曲线，并定义“特征尺度”作为识别性能显著退化起始点的紧凑度量。随后，我们考察了特征尺度与基线识别精度、模型参数量、架构系列以及表示稳定性之间的关系。我们观察到基线精度与特征尺度之间存在强烈的负相关关系。
tldr: 该研究通过评估20个跨七个架构系列的ImageNet预训练模型，发现基线识别精度与特征尺度之间存在强烈负相关，揭示了不同架构的视觉模型在尺度鲁棒性上具有共同的量化结构。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a strong inverse relationship between baseline accuracy and characteristic scale across 20 ImageNet models spanning seven architectural families, demonstrating that scale robustness exhibits a common quantitative structure across modern vision models.
